assertions: At desktop and phone widths, search changes to DuckDuckGo and survives reload.
At both widths, fetch changes to Direct HTTP and survives reload.
Both settings restore to Codex and survive another reload.
The browser route dialog opens and cancels at both widths.
remaining: A controlled second browser provider is needed for live route reordering.
Later-call routing is covered by existing unit evidence, not by this browser driver.
visualReview: Both screenshots inspected. Phone capture contains a dialog transition; no settled visual-layout claim.
setupCorrections: Removed an unused expect import before the successful driver execution.
